'''Chorto Rinn''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He headed the [[White Wing (group)|White Wing]], a branch of the [[Eagle's network]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], and oversaw the network's dealings with [[VerveGen Corporation]]. He was killed by [[Imperial Agent]] [[Cipher Nine]], who infiltrated VerveGen around [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="TOR" />
